correctness.rationale: The one-loop and two-component graph counterexamples are direct algebra calculations. The Ap tensor replacement is an elementary balanced-tensor identity.

value.rationale: The findings correct structural inputs used across the proposed induction/restriction framework and give precise repair principles: use actual vertex corners, Ap for hereditary-corner induction, and require isolated units for singleton isotropy embeddings or else use standard Steinberg isotropy machinery.
